text:
mae: Quick design chat 1  canary preview CTA + timeline copy. Problem: users mis-click canary vs main version in dense views. Need a clearer affordance and accessible labeling.

jia: Observed in tests: 'Canary' badge wasn't enough. People expected a preview that showed traffic % and when it started.

owen: Two ideas: 1) inline pill with 'Preview (10% traffic)' that expands to show details, 2) leave label but add an explicit 'Open Preview' action next to it.

mae: Copy options: "Open canary preview", "View canary (10% traffic)", "Preview traffic". Which is concise and low-alarm?

jia: Prefer "View canary (10%)"  short and clear. Avoid 'open' which is generic.

leon: A11y: make the pill a focusable button with aria-expanded and aria-controls to the preview panel. Announce traffic percent on focus using aria-describedby.

aria-bot: Accessibility checklist: add role=button, visible focus ring, ensure the preview panel has aria-live="polite" for updates, keyboard-only users need a clear Tab stop, and the preview toggle must have descriptive label e.g., "View canary: 10 percent traffic".

owen: Implementation nuance: for small screens we should collapse to a single icon + accessible label to save space. Use long-press to open details on touch.

mae: Telemetry: record which CTA variant used, preview open rate, and confusion metric (time-to-close without interacting). A/B for 2 weeks.

jia: I'll mock the inline pill + panel and the explicit action in Figma and post links. Will add 3 copy strings for review.

mae: Next steps: design mocks by tomorrow, eng to add aria attributes and telemetry hooks, A11y to run a quick SR check after prototype.

leon: note: ensure undo/rollback actions inside preview require a confirm modal and are announced. Don't let keyboard users accidentally trigger rollback from preview.

mae: thanks all :thumbsup:
